reuse.why: Uses the shared link.ensureAccountNotLinked and link.findOrCreateBank plus bankSync.syncAccount/handleSyncResponse, but re-pastes the upgrade-or-create account, transfer-payee, initial sync and sync-event sequence rather than factoring it, as every other link function in this tree also does.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount copies the ~50-line body of linkEnableBankingAccount and downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadEnableBankingTransactions, adding a sixth copy of the link sequence and another download copy.

placement.why: Each piece sits beside its siblings: SYNC_PROVIDERS, server-config base path, the link handler in accounts/app.ts, the download and dispatch in accounts/sync.ts, and the account type under types/models.

scope.why: Server side only, limited to the pieces the request lists.

maintainability.why: It matches the tree's per-provider copy pattern, so it is familiar, but it widens that pattern: any fix to linking (for example the duplicate-link or upgrade path) now needs one more edit.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The existing link helpers (ensureAccountNotLinked, findOrCreateBank) are used; the tree has no shared link-sequence function to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount and downloadFintegraTransactions are openly near-verbatim copies of the Enable Banking versions, only compacted slightly.
